items.title: Show HN: RAII and It's Architecture in C++
items.contentSnippet:
RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) is the core of C++ idiom. It is about the process and idea of how the object cleans up happens after itself and how a resource belongs to an object lifetime. Why it’s needed anyway, it’s because manually managing resources is easy to get wrong.

items.title: Show HN: Unofficial 3DS Port of F-Zero X Written by Claude Code
items.contentSnippet:
Hello HN! Sharing this because I think it's mind blowing, but I was able to port F-Zero X to 3DS using Claude Code. I learned quite a bit about how to guide Claude Code towards completing such a large project, but it's also filled me with quite a bit of dread. Still, I'm amazed that I can play this game in 3D at 60fps.
Thanks to Zorkats and inspectredc for their hardwork.
